meta.title: Laurel en Lienzo | Custom illustrations and creative workshops
meta.description: Catalog of custom illustrations, textiles and creative workshops. Exclusive handmade pieces to connect with you.

hero.title: <highlight>CREATE</highlight> FEEL CONNECT
hero.subtitle: Personalizable illustrations crafted down to the smallest detail so you can be part of them, adding colour or details. Creative workshops and exclusive pieces to take with you.

book.title: Florecillas
book.description: Welcome to my first illustrated book of poems. A journey of words and colour born from the small flowers of everyday life: verses to pause time, to feel, and to bloom.
